items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Well, Jack August was playing alto saxophone. I was playing the clarinet... Well, then we played together for a while

ctx.x: And in this band, Willie Webber used to play trumpet. Jack August used to play saxophone. And I did play the clarinet. Yeah, E-flat clarinet.
I was going to ask you, we might as well get back to that, just when you first took up music, what you started on, and about how old you were.
